study: Sun-2024 400 C SCW/CO2 2x2 factorial with rate-matched controls

source.flow_rate_reference_state: not reported; Figure 1 shows pump/intermediate-vessel delivery
source.pressure_control: outlet back-pressure regulator at Table 2 pressure
source.physical_stop_condition: source contains temperature-stable, 2 h, and 4 PV descriptions

locked_model.water_model: independent conserved SCW; IAPWS-IF97 density; McBride-Wright viscosity

required_runtime_declaration.warning: in_situ_volume is a declared sensitivity boundary because the paper omits the rate-meter reference state

convergence.co2_breakthrough_definition: first output interval with outlet/inlet CO2 component mass-rate ratio >= 0.01
convergence.mass_error_scale: max(initial inventory, current inventory, cumulative injected, cumulative produced)

interpretation.primary_factorial: pressure (23/24 MPa) x added CO2 (0/2 reported mL/min)

rate_confounding_controls.rule: pure-SCW reservoir total rate is resolved to exactly match R10/R12 under the same rate basis
